 Live .  10,100 viewing 10100 viewing Championship: West Ham 2-0 down at Blackburn, Burnley 4-3 up at Cardiff, Preston lead Saints
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scores 
 Tables 
 Summary
 West Ham 2-0 behind at Blackburn, Boro being held at Watford
 Burnley 4-3 up at Cardiff, bottom side Preston lead Southampton
 WBA ahead against Millwall, 10-man Swansea equalise at Birmingham
 Earlier, Wrexham 1-1 Wolves - O'Brien quickly cancels out Armstrong's opener 
 Norwich win 5-0 at Bristol City, Stoke come from behind to beat Portsmouth and go top
 Get Involved: Use yellow button
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Kate Holloway, Alex Hoad, Ben Kosky and Deepak Mahay
 Most recent Most popular get involved Get Involved published at 16:36 GMT 16:36 GMT 
 Use yellow button on page 
 West Ham are so odd to watch. Every game is like a training game, where we just pass it around really slowly, no urgency, no intent until (normally) the last 15-20 minutes when we start to panic. And we still can’t defend. Just awful.
 Dave, Cotswolds 
 While West Ham's defence is leaky, how much of that is down to our goalkeeper? 11 goals conceded in four matches and I don't think I've seen Hermansen make a save.
 Chris, London

 Graham Alexander has made four changes, trying to regain a foothold in the game, with one of them a debut for former Charlton skipper Greg Docherty.

 Blackburn 2-0 West Ham 
 A few shouts of 'You're not fit to wear the shirt' coming from the Darwen End.
 West Ham fans are NOT happy.

 'Urgency about Blues' published at 16:35 GMT 16:35 GMT 
 Birmingham 1-0 Swansea 
 Richard Wilford 
BBC Radio WM commentator 
 There is an urgency about Blues.
 Swansea have to maintain a bit of a threat otherwise they'll play into Blues' hands.

 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:34 GMT 16:34 GMT 
 Charlton 1-1 Sheff Utd 
 Blades goalscorer Jordan Ayew is withdrawn for the final 20 minutes or so as Tom Cannon is introduced from the bench by Chris Wilder.
 4 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:34 GMT 16:34 GMT 
 Birmingham 1-1 Swansea 
 So many huge chances for Birmingham not converted...
 Image source, Opta 
 11 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:32 GMT 16:32 GMT 
 Preston 1-0 Southampton 
 The traffic is one-way now and James Ward-Prowse has seen a trademark long-range blast charged down while Jack Stephens has nodded into the path of Leo Scienza on the right of the area but his effort is blocked too.
 48 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Good if Watford can counter the full-backs' published at 16:32 GMT 16:32 GMT 
 Watford 0-0 Middlesbrough 
 Geoff Doyle 
Commentator on BBC Three Counties Radio 
 If Watford could get a counter-attack on the two full-backs, who are both on yellow cards, that would be very good.
 13 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:32 GMT 16:32 GMT 
 QPR 1-1 Lincoln 
 Can either of these sides turn one point into three?
 Lincoln threatened to do it through Adam Reach, racing onto George Wickens' clearance but firing over the bar.
 QPR have had more of the ball again in this second half, but they can't find a way through, although Kwame Poku and substitute Ilias Chair both went close.
 7 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL: Birmingham 1-1 Swansea published at 16:31 GMT 16:31 GMT 
 Christoph Klarer OG (65 mins) 
 Well...
 A Swansea corner goes completely wrong for Blues as it's delivered into the middle box and hits Christoph Klarer's thigh to divert into the net.
 The visitors should be well out of it by now but here we are.
 126 67 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:30 GMT 16:30 GMT 
 Watford 0-0 Middlesbrough 
 Three quarters of the game gone, but finally Watford give Radek Vitek something to do as he saves low down from Iker Bravo.
 Boro have shaken things up with a double change, Kyle Joseph and Myles Peart-Harris coming on as Sebastian Berhalter and David Strelec make way.
 8 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 16:30 GMT 16:30 GMT 
 Charlton 1-1 Sheff Utd 
 The Blades keep coming.
 Harrison Burrows has unleashed a thunderous volley from the left of the box which is stopped by Addicks keeper Will Mannion.
 Can the hosts turn the tide, or just hold on?
 9 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL: Blackburn 2-0 West Ham published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Dapo Afolayan (71 mins) 
 That could be game over!
 West Ham defender Max Kilman goes down. Play carries on with the Hammers half expecting referee Thomas Kirk to stop.
 He doesn't and Dapo Afolayan certainly doesn't as he advances to the edge of the box and beats Mads Hermansen with a low drive.
 Kilman gets booked for protesting in the aftermath. Not sure that helped his case too much by getting up and dashing over to the ref. 
 144 160 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Very much finely balanced' published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Birmingham 1-0 Swansea 
 Colin Tattum 
Former Birmingham City media officer on BBC Radio WM 
 Image source, Getty Images This game is very much finely balanced.
 You would expect at some stage in this half for Swansea to carve out a chance.
 There's a long time to go but it could start to get a little edgy if Blues don't get another.
 13 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 16:28 GMT 16:28 GMT 
 Preston 1-0 Southampton 
 The visitors keep coming and Welington has just drawn a brilliant save from Lee Nicholls with a thunderous effort from well outside the box, tipping the ball over his bar.
 Going to be a long last 25 minutes or so.
 40 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL: Cardiff 2-4 Burnley published at 16:26 GMT 16:26 GMT 
 Yousef Salech (65 mins) 
 Cardiff just love a goal.
 Yousef Salech has only been on the pitch for a minute but he pounces of a ricocheted ball from a Burnley man to thrash it into the net on the turn.
 Another six goal thrilled for the Bluebirds then. Might it be more?
 57 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 16:25 GMT 16:25 GMT 
 West Brom 1-0 Millwall 
 Barney Stewart and Felix Horn Myhre are on for the Baggies in place of Aune Heggebo and Jimmy-Jay Morgan as the hosts seek to finish this game off.
